info.name: TienditaCampus — Colección Completa
info.description:
Colección completa de la API REST de TienditaCampus.
Proyecto Integrador — Universidad Politécnica de Chiapas.
Integrantes: Luis Emilio Jaras Sánchez, Jesel Moreno Suñiga, Héctor Isaac Espinoza Mendoza.

exec: pm.test('Has status field', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); });

body.raw:
{
  "email": "testuser@upchiapas.edu.mx",
  "password": "MiPassword123!",
  "firstName": "Carlos",
  "lastName": "González Pérez",
  "role": "seller",
  "campusLocation": "UD1",
  "major": "Ingeniería en Tecnologías de la Información e Innovación Digital",
  "acceptTerms": true
}

exec: pm.test('Has user and accessToken', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('user'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('accessToken'); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('token', j.accessToken); pm.environment.set('my_user_id', j.user.id); }

pm.test('Error message mentions special character', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); const msg = Array.isArray(j.message) ? j.message.join(' ') : j.message; pm.expect(msg.toLowerCase()).to.include('especial'); });
pm.test('Has requiresTwoFactor flag', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.requiresTwoFactor).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Has message', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('message'); });
pm.test('Has user and accessToken', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('user'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('accessToken'); });
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('token', j.accessToken); pm.environment.set('my_user_id', j.user.id);
pm.test('Has message', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('message'); });
pm.test('Has user fields', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('email'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('role'); });
pm.test('Has user data', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('firstName'); });
pm.test('Response is array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('array'); });
